 Live Reporting
 Charlotte Coates
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 13:28 GMT 13:28 GMT 
 HT: Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 24 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Credit to Man Utd' published at 13:26 GMT 13:26 GMT 
 HT: Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Stephen Warnock 
Match of the Day pundit 
 I've been impressed with Manchester United's shape. I think one thing that you've got to ask of United is to be tougher to play through. They've just looked more organised, more compact.
 Chelsea found it difficult. So credit to United in the way they've set up.
 173 72 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Estevao coming back was inevitable' published at 13:24 GMT 13:24 GMT 
 HT: Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Danny Murphy 
Match of the Day pundit 
 Estevao coming back in was inevitable. The fans have been screaming out for him. Chelsea have matched up Man United playing a similar way. They are using a back four instead of the three that Alonso likes and neither team is looking secure. So I expect goals.
 100 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:21 GMT 13:21 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 This game has all the energy of an under-8s match the morning after they have all been trick or treating. Unfortunately it also has a similar level of composure in front of goal.
 Matt, York 
 490 166 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:18 GMT 13:18 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Goalless at the break but United have been the better of the two sides. 
 Some boos from the home fans, too. 
 620 165 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'I'm loving this game' published at 13:17 GMT 13:17 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 I mean don't get me wrong I'm loving this game but you can't go from attack there, to one pass and then Chelsea are straight through. 
 241 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45+2 mins 45+2 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Romeo Lavia does so well to break up the United attack but his ball to set Pedro Neto on his way is awful. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 125 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's not good defending' published at 13:16 GMT 13:16 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Wesley Fofana is asleep again, Amad Diallo comes across and that's the second time now. 
 It's worrying from a Chelsea perspective. It's not good defending. 
 371 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 INJURY TIME published at 45+1 mins 45+1 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Into two minutes of added time in this intriguing first half. 
 92 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Chelsea are short with just two centre-forwards' published at 13:15 GMT 13:15 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 I think Chelsea have left themselves short with two centre forwards, if you look over and there's not a centre forward on the bench it's not good.
 With all the money they've spent, they're still short. 
 254 96 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 44 mins 44 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Harry Maguire is the next player to make a mistake and Pedro Neto latches on to it. 
 He glides into the box and aims for the far corner from the tightest of angles but he puts it wide. 
 Has to square it. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 201 86 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:14 GMT 13:14 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Entertaining game but mostly because no one can control it. I still think Chelsea have more to lose out of this one.
 Dave, Melbourne 
 Are Chelsea terrible in this game or United just too good in this game?
 Sanjay, London 
 320 106 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Amad spins Wesley Fofana again and he only has Mike Penders to beat but he puts it over the bar. A really poor finish but does Fofana clip him?
 Not enough for a penalty, VAR says. 
 201 197 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Man Utd 'switching it up' published at 13:13 GMT 13:13 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Danny Murphy 
Match of the Day pundit 
 Manchester United have made some good opportunities, it's just that final bit of quality. They'll be pleased with what they're creating. There's a little tweak at the moment with Fernandes on the left and Cunha in the 10. They're switching it up from an attacking perspective.
 227 111 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 42 mins 42 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Five minutes left in the half and Chelsea have a corner. 
 It just hits Moises Caicedo and bounces off the base of the post. He knew absolutely nothing about it.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 116 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:11 GMT 13:11 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 United are playing like the home team. Chelsea have no organisation, poor pressing and so scrappy with the ball. They don't look like they have a plan at all.
 Will, London 
 580 149 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 40 mins 40 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 You honestly wouldn't know the likes of Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers were on the pitch. They've been so quiet. 
 Chelsea need them two to start playing. 
 317 133 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Man Utd must stay focused published at 13:10 GMT 13:10 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Simon Stone 
BBC Sport Manchester United reporter at Stamford Bridge 
 Manchester United must stay focused here.
 They are playing well, they have had chances, they thought they were ahead but they are not.
 They cannot take their foot off the gas and they cannot afford to get disheartened.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 322 184 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Carrick has handled himself superbly' published at 13:10 GMT 13:10 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Regardless of Michael Carrick's coaching or managerial skills, he is a top fella and has handled himself superbly with everything that's going on. 
 791 132 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 39 mins 39 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 This time, Levi Colwill gets the first contact and Mike Penders mops up the danger.
